subject: short layered male hair, front view (D = pupil line to chin bottom)
reference_style: Monster Hunter Stories 3 (MHS3) anime toon style, adult male (Leo, official render)

silhouette.reference: Hair top 1.52 D above the pupils with two thin spikes standing up; hair half width 0.82 D above the ears; jagged outline of pointed clump tips, widest at the temples.
silhouette.ours: Hair top 1.51 D above the pupils with two small spikes at the top front; hair half width 0.99 D above the ears; outline of pointed clump tips, widest at the temples.

fringe.reference: About five big pointed clumps converge from the top onto the forehead; the longest central clump ends between the brows, others end at the brows; small triangles of forehead show between them.
fringe.ours: Five big pointed clumps and two small ones converge from the top onto the forehead; the longest central clump ends at the brow line (about 0.25 D above the pupils); small triangles of forehead show between them.

clumps.reference: Big flat leaf-shaped clumps with sharp pointed tips, thin dark outlines between clumps, darker brown recesses under the overlapping clumps.
clumps.ours: Big flat leaf-shaped clumps with sharp pointed tips, thin dark outlines between clumps, darker brown recesses under the overlapping clumps.

colour.reference: Flat warm light brown, dominant sRGB about (152,112,80); a band of thin pale strokes about (208,172,120) across the top a third of the way down; darker brown under the fringe.
colour.ours: Flat warm light brown, dominant sRGB about (168,128,88) in the light; a few thin pale strokes on some clumps; darker brown recesses.

sides.reference: Hair covers the temples down to about eye level with pointed tips, the top of the ear shows below.
sides.ours: Hair covers the temples down to about eye level with pointed tips, the top of the ear shows below.
